ns2:section.sectionText: Real-World Design: Honduras Water Project.Two-semester course (Fa14 and Sp15) to design and implement a water system and health program in a rural Honduran community. You will work closely with professional mentors on every stage of the project and have the opportunity to travel to Honduras during Spring Break 2015. The Spring Break travel is optional and will earn 1 additional credit hour. Open to undergraduates in all majors, all levels. (Graduate students see ENG 598 HWP). Meets in 2320 DCL.
